paragraphs: Ivo, Rav’s father. (See Abba bar Acha bar Salla.) Ivo said, “I was standing before Rabbi Elazar son of Rabbi Tzadok; they brought a willow, and he beat it without a blessing.” Rashi: Ivo, Rav’s father, Sukkah 44b. Yuchasin writes before Rabbi Elazar bar Yitzchak. Perhaps he was troubled that Rabbi Elazar son of Rabbi Tzadok was before the destruction—how could he be in Ivo’s time? But Asheri and Tur, Orach Chayyim, section 664, read Rabbi Elazar son of Rabbi Tzadok; see the lengthy discussion there.
